rules.note: Personal documents: passport, plus ID or residence card if you have one. Upload as JPG or PDF.
Personal photo, part of the personal documents.
Certified certificates for your bachelor's (and higher diploma or PG certificate, if any). Degrees from outside Oman need authentication and equivalency from Oman's Ministry of Higher Education.
Official transcripts for your bachelor's (and higher diploma or PG certificate, if any).
IELTS or TOEFL iBT certificate. Applications are cancelled if it is not attached.
Study leave or employer approval letter, as listed in the official table.
